card.name: The end of interleukin before a number
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and a number such as -1, -2 or -6. It also fires weakly partway through a few other long words, such as Tuscany and embryo-fetal.

modes.label: Interleukin name
modes.description: The last piece of "interleukin" right before a hyphen and a number or an (IL) abbreviation.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Partway through other long or unusual words, in place names, in medical terms, or in non-Latin script.
